model: libvirtd + QEMU system emulator on Debian 12

capture.command: Privileged container run with --init; apt-get install --no-install-recommends libvirt-daemon-system libvirt-clients qemu-system-x86 qemu-utils openssh-server netbase dnsmasq-base iptables iproute2; virtlogd -d; libvirtd -d (libvirtd.conf: unix_sock_group = libvirt, unix_sock_rw_perms = 0770, auth_unix_rw = none, as polkit has no D-Bus in the lab); dir pool 'lab' with qcow2 volumes app01-root (2G) and db01-root (4G); network 'default' started; domain lab-app01 (type qemu, 1 vCPU, 256 MiB, virtio disk volume, virtio NIC on network default, autostart, running) and lab-db01 (2 vCPU, 512 MiB, virtio disk volume, empty SATA cdrom, user-mode e1000 NIC, shut off). Neither guest has an operating system, so guest-agent and lease addresses are empty. The real kvm_libvirt collector binary (apps/collectors/cmd/kvm_libvirt) ran libvirt.Script() over SSH as unprivileged user 'openmap' (member of group libvirt) against 127.0.0.1:<published sshd port>; the raw stdout it stored as cli_output evidence is copied here byte-for-byte.
